textos.Llegué a las pesas de rebote. Tenía cato: I got into lifting by chance. I was fourteen or fifteen, training jiu-jitsu at a small gym, and the membership also gave access to the weight room: four machines, some bars and a few plates. Nobody was waiting for me there. One day I walked through the door out of curiosity and never left.
textos.Era 1996. En casa casi nadie tenía inter: It was 1996. Hardly anyone had internet at home, and there were no videos explaining a squat or articles about weekly volume. You learned by watching the people who had been training for years, copying what they did and asking. And almost always someone gave you a hand.
textos.Eso es lo que nunca se me ha olvidado: e: That is what I have never forgotten: in the gym, what you know is shared.
textos.Hoy pasa lo contrario. La información so: Today it's the opposite. There is plenty of information, but it comes wrapped in sales: the calculator asks for your email, the routine comes with a subscription and the tip ends in a discount code. Anyone starting today is as lost as I was in 1996, only with much more noise.
textos.ArnoldWork nace para devolver lo que me: ArnoldWork exists to give back what those veterans gave me. That is why everything that helps you train is free and needs no sign-up: the tools, the HeavyWork method, the guide and even the game. It is not a trick to sell you something later. It is how I learned things worked in a gym.
